card.name: Linking words before 'other drugs' interactions
card.fires_on: The small words 'on' or 'are' right before a mention of other drugs or enzyme substrates in drug-interaction sections. Seen in headings like 'Effect of [drug] on Other Drugs' and in phrases like 'drugs that are substrates of'.

modes.label: Effect of drug on other drugs
modes.description: The word 'on' in a section heading after 'Effect of [brand name]'.
modes.example: 7.2 Effect of INREBIC<< on>> Other Drugs CYP3A4,

modes.label: Drugs that are substrates
modes.description: The word 'are' after 'drugs that' or 'products that', before an enzyme or transporter substrate term.
modes.example: Coadministration of VOSEVI with drugs that<< are>> substrates of these transporters may alter

card.plain: It marks the little word in drug-interaction text that leads into other drugs affected by the medicine, such as CYP3A substrates.
